Recalculate every formula before saving.
Load every default value before saving.

api.description: Update only the fields you send on one record, edit a subtable row by its row id, or delete one with _DELSUB_

fields.description: The account name from your Ragic URL, such as "demo" in www.ragic.com/demo/sales.
The folder path from your URL, starting with a slash, such as /sales.
The sheet number from your URL, the number after the folder path.

Field ID to value, only for the fields to change. A multi-select takes an array; a date needs yyyy/MM/dd or yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss. A subtable is `_subtable_<id>` keyed by row id: an existing row’s positive id (read from the record) edits that row, a negative id adds a new row. `_DELSUB_<subtable id>` with an array of row ids deletes those rows.
Recalculate every formula before saving.
Load every default value before saving.
Run link and load operations: true after the formula recalculation, "first" before it. Either way doFormula must also be set when a recalculation is needed.
False skips the workflow scripts, which otherwise run.
False skips the AI Agents, which otherwise run.
Defaults to true: the save sends notifications.
Run the sheet’s field validation rules first. A failing field rejects the save.
Refuse the update when the record is locked. Without it Ragic ignores the lock and saves the update.
The record id, which is the _ragicId value.
SUCCESS when the record was saved.
The record id (_ragicId).
The saved record, keyed by field ID, with its reserved keys.
